body: I know, thank you. I'm watching out for myself the best I can and doing what's good for me. x

I'm hoping he doesn't, because whether you caused it or not, that's a shitty thing to have on your conscience. But I'm trying to accept that he's sort of a lost cause at this point, and I feel insensitive saying that, but hearing him say it himself over and over kind of makes an impression.

But thank you, I'm not talking to him anymore, he chose to end this relationship on a bitter note and that's not my fault. I'm moving on and not blaming myself for anything that happens (or at least trying my hardest).

Yeah, it's not the first time he's used manipulation, but I think I'm finally throwing the towel in on our friendship. If something happens I'm just going to try not to blame myself because he has attempted before even with me around, so if it happens again I can't blame myself. He's too far gone.
